lanes.title: Harden worker browser runtime: sandbox, non-root, session files, retry after mutation, artifact redaction
lanes.description:
Source-only hardening from the 2026-10-03 codebase review (Linear OVD-593, priority Urgent).

## Acceptance criteria (from OVD-593)
- [ ] AC1: Worker image runs Chromium as a non-root user with the sandbox enabled by default; deploy script default no longer disables it. STATUS: the non-root user and explicit chromiumSandbox wiring are in the PR; the deploy-script default flip and the Cloud Run smoke are PROTECTED and tracked in child issue OVD-610. AC1 therefore stays open and must remain unticked; it is owner-blocked, not a defect of this PR.
- [ ] AC2: Vendor auth tools write storageState files with 0600.
- [ ] AC3: Plain (non-VendorAutomationError) errors are not retried once a provider mutation (upload/config) may have started, for every adapter generation.
- [ ] AC4: Teardown rethrows the original quote failure before a snapshot failure.
- [ ] AC5: Xometry/Fictiv HTML captures go through the same redaction as providerPortalKernel before upload. (Screenshot/trace masking is child issue OVD-611.)
- [ ] AC6: Tests cover each behavior; worker verify passes.

## Known owner-blocked items (report as owner-blocked, never as satisfied)
- AC1 deploy default flip + Cloud Run smoke (OVD-610).
- Commit c01722e's message carries a release-parent identifier; history cannot be rewritten; the merge must use a curated squash message.
- The worker Docker image is not built by CI; a real sandboxed Chromium/Camoufox launch as pwuser is unverified (OVD-610).
- CodeRabbit reviewed through 7fd1b9a (2 threads resolved) but is rate-limited for cac279f.

## Verification commands
npx vitest run worker/src/chromiumLaunchOptions.test.ts worker/src/adapters/providerEvidenceRedaction.test.ts worker/src/tools/probeXometryProfileAuth.test.ts scripts/deploy-cloud-run-contract.test.mjs
npx vitest run <the 13 PR-touched test files listed in the PR body>
npm --prefix worker run verify
npm run lint && npm run typecheck
Mutation checks on scratch copies: remove a redaction clause, remove a guard, add an unguarded chromium launcher; each must be caught.
lanes.guidance: Review the WHOLE PR diff (084b48c..cac279f, 32 files) with security lenses: Dockerfile/non-root/user namespaces, storageState 0600, retry-after-mutation semantics per adapter generation, teardown error precedence, DOM redaction regexes (ReDoS, over/under-redaction), chromium sandbox guard test. Base is #564; use /home/user/wt/base564 node_modules symlinks. Prior findings: prior2-U572.json (at a659e9b) and the round-1/round-2 results summarized in the PR's correction comment (issuecomment-5985442685) and merge-decision history.
lanes.verification: See description. Hosted CI at cac279f: 15/15 success (run 37244093261, browser-test on attempt 2 after a known fixture-lane first-mount flake).
